listing.name: Resident Evil: The Umbrella Chronicles / Resident Evil: The Umbrella Chronicles PC native port (solleo95)
listing.summary: Resident Evil: The Umbrella Chronicles running natively on Windows, Linux and Steam Deck: unlocked FPS, mouse aiming, DLSS / FSR 3.1 + frame generation, ray-traced shadows, HDR, Lua/JS/DLL mods, online co-op. Bring your own NTSC-U (RBUE08) image.
